detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A static side view of a long heavy bolt-action sniper rifle on a bipod on a concrete firing line at an outdoor range, wide open fields behind it. It fires exactly one round: a big muzzle flash and recoil, then it is still. The camera is static and locked-off.

overall_soundscape: Foley recording, close microphone: one single huge sniper rifle gunshot, a deep heavy boom with a hard supersonic crack, followed by a long rolling echo across the open fields that fades out over two seconds, then silence. Nothing else is heard: no music, no speech, no voices.
